text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. Heading toward the 
Shuka Sho, Fusaichi Pandora was... blazing 
with pure passion!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Deryaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What's next!? What's the next 
training session!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her attitude, having cast aside all 
complacency. Her ravenous determination to 
take on any challenge— She's not the same 
girl she used to be!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's keep this momentum going!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hehh, hahh... Pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... so brutal... Summer is the 
worst...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"B-But I'm trying... I'm trying so, so 
hard...!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll do my best tomorrow too! Ice 
down, go straight home, and rest up...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer said we can play in the 
ocean~! Let's gooo~!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's so nice...! That has got to 
feel so good...♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no no no! No playing around. I'm 
going home. Yep!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Going home, going home, straight home—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, shaved ice♡ And it's Taiwanese style 
with milky ice♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, no no! I won't play with you! 
No!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that bath felt so good♡ Alright, 
today I'm just gonna head straight to b—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Aaaah! Buena-chan and the others' curry 
party~~!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (They're having a barbecue over there~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, ah... must be nice...! It's gotta be 
delicious... and so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I found Fusaichi Pandora writhing in agony 
in the hallway. Apparently, she's trying 
desperately to resist the urge to go goof 
off...
choice_data_list: Why don't you go while you're on break?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
choice_data_list: Besides, you've really been working hard.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Trainer... ~~~~~gah!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I don't waaaaant it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaaaaah~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hurriedly chasing after her... 
Fusaichi Pandora was simply sprinting with 
all her might.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Still no waaaay~~!! Part of me still wants 
to play around a bit!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally serious! This time, I'm for 
real, totally serious!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to go all out for the Shuka 
Sho! I want to win!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was out of breath and staggering, so I 
went over to support her.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...If I play even once, I feel like I'll 
melt away.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I feel like we'd probably end up just 
goofing around and playing. In fact, I'm 
almost certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's why... you can't!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...In her own way, she was probably 
confronting that marshmallow heart of 
hers."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result, I decided I had no choice but 
to ruthlessly avoid temptation and stay 
disciplined...!
choice_data_list:
...So that's how you decided to give it 
your all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, no tempting me! I'm trying my 
hardest here!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...! That's right, 'cause I'm a genius!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I can do this! I'm sooooo fired up--!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I will sever all temptation—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our fists thrust high into the air 
together. This summer, I resolved to strip 
away all distractions and guide her to the 
very top...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're crying here?! That's totally 
unfair, come on!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh~... Well, I'm gonna pull it off! Just 
you watch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her declaration shines so brilliantly. No 
matter how tough it might be to resist 
summer's temptations, I resolved to 
support her with everything I have.
